More than a typical retail outlet, the new store brings together high-performance running gear and community spaces to create a hub for local runners, featuring immersive displays and multi-category presentations that offer a full range of running products. It also provides dedicated services for professional runners, including marathon events, training camps, coaching sessions, and pacer programs....
